Aluminium metal is extracted from its purified ore by electrolysis.
Which statement about the electrolyte in this process is correct?
A
The electrolyte is purified molten bauxite only.
B
The electrolyte is purified bauxite dissolved in molten cryolite.
C
The electrolyte is purified molten cryolite only.
D
The electrolyte is purified cryolite dissolved in molten bauxite.

options.label: A
options.text: The electrolyte is purified molten bauxite only.

options.label: B
options.text: The electrolyte is purified bauxite dissolved in molten cryolite.

options.label: C
options.text: The electrolyte is purified molten cryolite only.

options.label: D
options.text: The electrolyte is purified cryolite dissolved in molten bauxite.
